privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: Speakio ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable French law.
privacy.dataCollectedIntro: When you create an account and use Speakio, we collect the following personal data:
privacy.dataEmail: Email address — required for account creation and authentication.
privacy.dataUsername: Username — required for public identification on the platform.
privacy.dataPassword: Password — stored as a secure bcrypt hash. We never store your plain-text password.
privacy.dataAvatar: Profile picture — optional, uploaded by you or imported from Google.
privacy.dataLocale: Interface language preference — to display the platform in your language.
privacy.dataLanguages: Learning languages — to personalize your experience.
privacy.dataOAuthIntro: If you sign up with Google, we also receive:
privacy.dataGoogleId: Google ID — to link your Google account.
privacy.dataGoogleEmail: Google email — used as your account email.
privacy.dataGooglePicture: Google profile picture — used as your default avatar.
privacy.dataUGCIntro: We also store content you create on the platform:
privacy.dataRoadmaps: Learning roadmaps (steps, substeps, vocabularies) — private to your account.
privacy.cookiesText: Speakio uses a single strictly necessary cookie (access_token) to keep you authenticated. This cookie expires after 7 days. We do not use any analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies.
privacy.purposeAccount: Account management — creating and managing your user account.
privacy.purposeContent: Content delivery — displaying your posts, comments, roadmaps, and votes.
privacy.purposePersonalization: Personalization — displaying resources in your preferred language.
privacy.purposeSecurity: Security — authenticating your identity and protecting your account.
privacy.basisContract: Contractual necessity (Art. 6.1.b GDPR) — for account management, authentication, and platform features.
privacy.basisConsent: Consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) — for optional data such as your avatar, bio, and Google OAuth.
privacy.basisLegitimate: Legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR) — for improving the platform and maintaining security.
privacy.retentionText: Your personal data is retained for the duration of your account. If you delete your account, your personal data is anonymized or permanently deleted within 30 days. Content you published (posts, comments) may be anonymized and retained for the continuity of community content.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.rightAccess: Right of access — request a copy of all your personal data.
privacy.rightRectification: Right to rectification — correct inaccurate personal data.
privacy.rightErasure: Right to erasure — request deletion of your personal data.
privacy.rightPortability: Right to data portability — export your data in a machine-readable format.
privacy.rightOpposition: Right to object — object to certain types of processing.
privacy.rightRestriction: Right to restriction — request limitation of processing.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, go to Settings > Account or contact us at the email address listed in the Legal Notice.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures including bcrypt password hashing, HTTPS encryption, CORS protection, rate limiting, and input validation to protect your data.
privacy.cnilText: If you believe your data protection rights have not been respected, you have the right to file a complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL) at www.cnil.fr.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceText: By creating an account or using Speakio, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.serviceText: Speakio is a community-curated directory of language learning resources. Users can discover, vote on, and save resources; create personalized learning roadmaps; write blog posts; and leave comments.
terms.accountText: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
terms.contentText: You retain ownership of any content you create on Speakio (posts, comments, roadmaps). By publishing content, you grant Speakio a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to display and distribute your content on the platform. You may delete your content at any time.
terms.conductIntro: When using Speakio, you agree not to:
terms.conductHarassment: Harass, bully, or threaten other users.
terms.conductSpam: Post spam, advertisements, or irrelevant promotional content.
terms.conductIllegal: Post illegal, defamatory, or obscene content.
terms.conductInfringement: Infringe on the intellectual property rights of others.
terms.conductImpersonation: Impersonate another person or misrepresent your identity.
terms.ipText: The Speakio platform, including its name, logo, design, and code, is the property of its creators. The resources listed on the platform belong to their respective owners; Speakio only provides links and descriptions.
terms.terminationText: You may delete your account at any time from Settings > Account. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. Upon deletion, your personal data will be anonymized or removed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
terms.liabilityText: Speakio is provided "as is" without warranties. We are not responsible for the quality, accuracy, or availability of third-party resources listed on the platform. We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
terms.modificationText: We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make significant changes, we will notify you by updating the date at the top of this page. Your continued use of Speakio constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.lawText: These Terms are governed by French law. Any disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts in France.

notice.liabilityText: The publisher strives to provide accurate and up-to-date information but cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or relevance of all content on the site, particularly user-generated content and third-party resource descriptions.
